text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, during our busy routine of 
training, Super Creek called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan is growing vegetables. Would you 
like to go take a look with me for a 
little break?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, you have so many different vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pretty great, huh? My little siblings 
saved up their pocket money to send me 
these seeds.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're for my younger siblings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They say if ya eat heaps of tasty veggies, 
yer legs'll get way faster.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm tellin' ya, it takes time for 
'em to grow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Tama-chan looks so happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Once they grow big and strong, I'll 
feed some to you guys too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after going to see Tamamo 
Cross's field, I was discussing training 
with Super Creek when—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... And here I even gave it 
fertilizer, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, what's up? Did ya need somethin' 
from meâ
choice_data_list: Wait, what was that about fertilizer……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are the vegetables looking a bit wilted, 
by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... haha, yeah, that's right. Just a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll manage somehow! Don't you worry 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“...... Um, Tama-chan. If you'd like, 
shall we look into it together?”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Investigate what?
choice_data_list: How to Make Your Veggies More Vibrant!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't worry about it. You guys are busy 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like there's a pro 
conveniently around. It won't be easy to 
look into, so it'll take time—
choice_data_list:
There should be someone who knows more 
about it.

There should be someone who knows more 
about it!

It won't take long if we all look into it 
together.

If we all look into it together, it'll be 
done in no time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like there's a pro 
conveniently around. It won't be easy to 
look into, so it'll take time—
choice_data_list:
There should be someone who knows more 
about it.

There should be someone who knows more 
about it!

It won't take long if we all look into it 
together.

If we all look into it together, it'll be 
done in no time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Like Flower-chan, for 
instance. Shall we go ask her together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: By Flower, you mean Nishino Flower?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no reason for you guys to tag 
along. I'll go ask myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wouldn't it be better if we all 
cheered those girls up together?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan, Trainer-san, and me. Let's 
shower them with love, the three of us 
together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Anything shines brighter when it is raised 
with lots of love, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
L-Love, she says... She really says 
embarrassing stuff like that with a 
straight face, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...They're just ordinary veggies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though you don't really think 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides, vegetables aren't the only thing 
I want to pour my love into.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to pour loooots of love into my 
beloved Tama-chan too♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need it! Your love is way too 
sappy!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, getting all embarrassed. How 
adorable~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tamamo Cross's bashful reaction, 
Super Creek gave her a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Listen here. You guys are meddling way 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want your help if it means 
holding up your own training."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Tama-chan says so, but what do 
you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: That's one thing, but this is another.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's so true~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, that makes zero sense! What the heck 
are ya talkin' about?!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, please give up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Training is important of course, but you 
can make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, vegetables are precious living 
things. Let's all help them together, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It is a precious life given to me by 
someone precious. ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. Creek is right."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry 'bout this! Appreciate the help!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, with pleasure♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek returned Tamamo Cross's 
cheerful thanks with a warm smile.
